144: def encode_private_bootstrap(binding, master_key):
145:     # This packet is only for the controller-created, inherited private pipe.
146:     # It must not be logged, placed on a command line, or accepted from a file.
147:     _require(type(binding) is GenerationBinding and type(master_key) is bytes and len(master_key) == 32,
148:              "private_bootstrap_material")
149:     binding.encoded()
